minor.issue: Both endpoints return 404 Not Found. UI's two-step fallback chain (compose-from-master → generate-composition) gracefully surfaces a toast.error but the user cannot actually trigger the canonical 'Compose From Master' action server-side. AdaptationOperationsPanel.composeFromMaster() works as designed (no silent no-op, error toast displayed), but the underlying capability is not wired.

action_items: (LOW) Implement POST /api/editorial/variants/{vid}/compose-from-master server-side OR ensure /generate-composition exists so the AdaptationOperationsPanel 'Compose From Master' action works end-to-end. Currently both 404 → user sees error toast 'Composizione fallita' which is graceful but functionally blocking.

(NITPICK) Mobile breakpoint in editorial.css is @media (max-width:639px) — spec lists '640x800 mobile' which sits AT the boundary (640 is NOT mobile per the CSS). If the intent is to include 640 as mobile, change to max-width:640px. Currently testing at 600 correctly triggers chip; 640 falls back to laptop layout.
critical_code_review_comments: AdaptationOperationsPanel.restoreComposition uses confirm() then calls patch + composeFromMaster sequentially; if composeFromMaster fails (which it currently does — 404), the metadata patch already persisted preserve_manual:false. Consider a transactional flow OR show the failure as 'metadata aggiornato ma composizione fallita' to avoid silent partial-success state.

MarketMatrixPage.InlineEditableCell calls load() (full re-fetch) after every successful PATCH. With 15 rows × multiple cells this is fine, but consider optimistic local update + revert-on-error to remove the visible round-trip flicker — especially for power users editing many cells.

EditorialContextRail.computeNextStep does not consider variant.metadata_json.preserve_manual or .manual_locked when surfacing 'Re-sync' suggestions in the advisory bar. Once Lock Manual is applied, the rail could acknowledge the locked state ('Manuale bloccato — sblocca per re-sync') instead of pushing toward composition workflows.
